question: Why was VOL_REGIME inconsistent in Phase 39-R?

findings.regime_persistence: Volatility regimes persist for weeks but transition timing creates noise
findings.horizon_dependence: VOL_REGIME positive at H-20, negative at H-10 — HORIZON_DEPENDENT
